explanation:
[EFFECT] The effect of hour on hourly demand is non-monotonic — it rises and falls across the range. Its shape is category-dependent, with the contribution highest around 17:00.

[IMPORTANCE] Hour ranks 1 of 9 features by global importance (importance 0.889) — one of the strongest drivers of demand.

[RECOMMENDATION] Account for hour when planning bikes and staff: demand is highest around 17:00, so allocate more there and less at the opposite end.
